A member of Squad AR, she is calmer and more composed now than she once was. After M4's departure and her parting from the Commander, she came to treasure the companions at her side all the more. She is results-driven and cares little for process; taciturn and disinclined to explain herself, she is often misunderstood. Usually it is only after she has quietly given a great deal that others realise her good intentions — and that is her own gentle way of caring for people.
